Really tasty and perfect service
Aug 2026 • Family
After almost three weeks of enjoying the amazing Vietnamese cuisine every single day, our family of five (including one vegetarian) felt like having something different for a change. We decided to try this Indian restaurant, and it turned out to be one of the best dining experiences of our entire trip.

At first, we were a little surprised that the restaurant wasn’t very busy. However, the elegant interior, spotless cleanliness, and welcoming atmosphere immediately made a great impression. Any doubts disappeared the moment we were greeted by the staff.

The service was simply outstanding. Our waiter was incredibly kind, attentive, and genuinely friendly. He made us feel welcome from the first minute, and we even enjoyed a nice little chat with him during the evening. His warm personality made the experience even more memorable.

The food exceeded all of our expectations. We ordered a wide variety of dishes—chicken, fish, vegetarian curries, dal, naan, and several other Indian specialties—and every single dish was beautifully presented, perfectly seasoned, and absolutely delicious. Even after weeks of fantastic Vietnamese food, this meal stood out as a real highlight.

If you’re looking for authentic, high-quality Indian cuisine in Vietnam, this restaurant is an absolute gem. Excellent food, a beautiful and clean restaurant, outstanding service, and wonderful hospitality. We would return without hesitation and highly recommend it to anyone looking for an unforgettable Indian meal.

Amazing Authentic Indian Experience
Jun 2025 • Family
We had an incredible dining experience at Jalsa Indian Restaurant! From the moment we walked in, the warm hospitality and vibrant ambiance made us feel right at home. The food was absolutely delicious — every dish was rich in flavor and beautifully presented.

We tried the Paneer Butter Masala, Garlic Naan, and Vegetable Biryani — all were cooked to perfection with authentic Indian spices. The service was fast and friendly, and the staff made sure we were comfortable throughout the meal.

Highly recommended for anyone looking to enjoy true Indian cuisine in a cozy and welcoming environment. We’ll definitely be coming back again!
